description: If you're searching for a 2022 Kia Sportage LX for sale in Fontana, California, this black AWD Sport Utility has everything a smart buyer is looking for  a modern nameplate, all-wheel drive capability, and a price that makes serious sense at just $14,999. Available now at AMERICAN FLEET in Fontana, in San Bernardino County, this 2022 Sportage LX comes in at 92,632 miles and represents one of the better used SUV values you'll find in the Inland Empire right now.About This 2022 Kia Sportage LXThe 2022 Kia Sportage is the final model year of the fourth-generation Sportage before a full redesign, which means this vehicle benefits from years of refinement and well-documented reliability data. At just under 93,000 miles, this Sportage sits comfortably in its prime working years  these crossovers routinely push well past 150,000 miles with normal maintenance. The striking black exterior gives it a sharp, assertive look, and as a clean SUV body style, it offers everyday practicality that sedans simply can't match. Whether you're commuting on the 10 Freeway or loading up for a weekend trip, this Sportage is sized just right.2022 Kia Sportage Performance and EngineUnder the hood, this Sportage LX is powered by a 2.4-liter four-cylinder engine with Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI), producing around 181 horsepower and paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission. The AWD system is a genuine differentiator in this price range  it actively distributes power between the front and rear wheels based on road conditions, giving you added confidence on wet roads, light off-road terrain, and mountain passes heading toward Big Bear or Wrightwood. The 2.4-liter GDI engine is known for delivering a solid balance between power and fuel efficiency, returning approximately 23 MPG city and 30 MPG highway  respectable numbers for an all-wheel drive crossover in this class.Kia Sportage LX Features and InteriorTechnology and ComfortThe 2022 Sportage LX trim delivers a well-rounded feature set without the unnecessary complexity of higher trims. Inside, you'll find a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment display with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay compatibility, making it simple to stay connected whether you're navigating to Ontario, Rancho Cucamonga, or beyond. The interior offers a comfortable seating layout for five passengers, with cloth upholstery, automatic climate control, and thoughtful storage throughout the cabin.Safety FeaturesEven at the LX base trim level, Kia included a comprehensive active safety suite on 2022 models, including Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist, Lane Keeping Assist, and Driver Attention Warning. These aren't optional add-ons  they're standard equipment, which speaks to Kia's overall value proposition at every trim level. The Sportage earned strong safety scores from both NHTSA and IIHS in its generation, giving buyers peace of mind on California's busiest highways.Kia Sportage Reliability and OwnershipThe Kia Sportage has built a strong reputation for long-term dependability over the past decade, and the 2022 model year continues that trend. Consumer Reports and J.D. What this vehicle includes:               Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. What this vehicle includes:               Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicles private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. description: This 2018 Chevrolet Cruze LT offers the dependable performance and practical design that makes this sedan a solid choice for drivers seeking reliable daily transportation. - 1.4L 4-Cylinder Turbo engine with 6-Speed Automatic transmission - Chevrolet MyLink 7' Touch-Screen with AM/FM and SiriusXM Satellite Radio - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility - Rear backup camera - OnStar Guidance emergency communication - Front and rear parking assistance - 6-Speaker audio system with steering wheel-mounted controls - Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature - Air conditioning with rear window defroster - Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry - Power windows, mirrors, and steering - Front bucket seats with manual adjusters - Split folding rear seats for cargo flexibility - 16' aluminum alloy wheels The Cruze delivers practical features designed for everyday comfort. The MyLink infotainment system keeps you connected with smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while SiriusXM satellite radio provides entertainment options. Climate control includes air conditioning and a rear window defroster to handle seasonal changes. The interior offers front bucket seats and a rear seat center armrest, with split folding rear seats that expand your cargo capacity when needed. Safety receives proper attention with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and knee and overhead airbags for comprehensive protection. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and 4-wheel disc ABS brakes contribute to confident handling. The rear backup camera aids parking awareness, while brake assist enhances stopping capability. Fuel efficiency is a strong point with this sedan, delivering 29 mpg in the city and 40 mpg on the highway. The 1.4L turbocharged engine balances power and economy, while front-wheel drive provides practical traction. Power steering and a telescoping tilt steering wheel accommodate various driver preferences. description: The 2015 Lexus GS 350 Sedan 4D stands as an exceptionally balanced, highly sophisticated benchmark in the mid-size luxury executive sedan segment, representing a standout model year for the fourth-generation (L10) GS platform. Built on an ultra-rigid chassis architecture featuring extensive high-strength steel bracing and lightweight aluminum suspension components, this four-door sports saloon trades floaty executive ride characteristics for razor-sharp steering feedback, whisper-quiet cabin insulation, and legendary long-term Lexus reliability.Under the sculpted aluminum hood sits Lexus's smooth, naturally aspirated 3.5-liter DOHC 24-valve V6 engine(2GR-FSE), featuring dual VVT-i variable valve timing and the D-4S direct-and-port fuel injection system. This bulletproof mechanical core hammers out a potent 306 horsepower at 6,400 RPM and 277 lb-ft of torque at 4,800 RPM. Power is managed by a lightning-fast 8-speed Sport Direct-Shift automatic transmission with paddle shifters on Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD) models, or a heavy-duty 6-speed automatic transmission on All-Wheel Drive (AWD) builds. Power is routed via RWD or through an intelligent AWD system with a planetary-gear center differential that maintains a 30:70 rear-wheel bias during normal driving, splitting up to 50:50 when wheel slip is detected. Supported by a double-wishbone front and multi-link rear suspension with standard Drive Mode Select (ECO, Normal, Sport S, and available Sport S+ on F Sport models), the GS 350 launches from 0 to 60 MPH in just 5.7 seconds on its way to an electronically limited top track speed of 142 MPH.On the exterior, the 2015 GS 350 executes a bold, aerodynamic visual statement highlighted by Lexus's iconic spindle grille with chrome surround, arrowhead LED daytime running lights, projector-beam High-Intensity Discharge (HID) headlights, and integrated rear bumper exhaust diffusers. Functional body contours feature power-folding auto-dimming heated side mirrors with memory and reverse tilt-down, deep-tinted glass, dynamic rain-sensing windshield wipers, a power tilt/slide sunroof, a power trunk lid, and an assertive stance rolling proudly on 18-inch 5-spoke aluminum alloy wheels (or available 19-inch split-five-spoke wheels on F Sport models) wrapped in performance all-season tires.Inside, the driver-centric cockpit welcomes up to five occupants into an Japanese luxury sanctuary lined with real matte bamboo or dark walnut wood trim accents, dynamic ambient lighting, and deeply cushioned seating draped in supple leather upholstery. Comfort amenities include 10-way power-adjustable front seats with driver memory, multi-stage heating and ventilation for the front seats, a heated leather-wrapped sport multifunction steering wheel with power tilt/telescoping adjustment, Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control with S-Flow air management, SmartAccess keyless entry with push-button start, auto-dimming mirrors, and a power rear sunshade. High-end digital connectivity centers around the 12.3-inch high-resolution widescreen display with Remote Touch Controller, featuring 3D Navigation, Bluetooth hands-free phone integration and audio streaming, Siri Eyes Free integration, HD Radio, SiriusXM satellite radio, dual USB ports, Lexus Enform App Suite, and a rich 12-speaker Lexus Premium Audio System (or available studio-quality 17-speaker 835-watt Mark Levinson Premium Surround Sound System).Practicality and space utilization match its top-tier executive touring profile thanks to its generous 112.2-inch wheelbase. Rear passengers enjoy adult-friendly legroom and headroom alongside a fold-down center armrest with integrated climate/media controls. Opening the power trunk lid reveals 14.3 cubic feet of flat cargo trunk space, providing an expansive, well-shaped area to transport luggage sets, tools, media gear packages, or daily commercial inventory.
